Nenad

Following your report and after our investigation, we found that the issue is related to the emergency button. However, we understand that the charger does not have an emergency button.
In some way, the root cause of the issue appears to be linked to an emergency  event. To better identify the cause, could you please provide the timestamp when this issue occurred so that we can analyze the logs in more detail and determine the exact problem?
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
